description: Start a browser session. Defaults to patchright chromium headed Chrome with a persistent profile.

cdpEndpoint.description: Existing Chrome remote debugging endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9222

device.description: Emulate a device from the Playwright registry, e.g. "iPhone 15", "Pixel 7". Sets viewport, UA, scale factor, and touch.

geolocation.description: Spoof geolocation. Grants the geolocation permission automatically.

mobile.description: Enable mobile emulation (touch + mobile hints) without a full device descriptor.

proxy.description: Proxy for this session (persistent launch only). Keep IP country consistent with locale/timezone/geo to avoid bot detection.

recordVideo.description: Record a video of the whole session. Pass true for defaults, or an object to customize. Saved as .webm; files finalize on browser_close. Not available over cdpEndpoint.

height.description: Video height. Defaults to viewport height.

width.description: Video width. Defaults to viewport width.

name: browser_start
